input.content:
# EV battery recycling rates: what the 2026 data says
_Prepared 2026-10-25 · 2 sources read_

## Bottom line
Recovery is high at plants that use hydrometallurgy, but only a minority of retired packs reach recyclers.

## Key findings
- Plant-level lithium recovery around 90% with hydrometallurgy [1].
- About 40% of retired EV packs collected for recycling in 2025 (estimate) [1].

## Open questions
- EU 2026 figures: the peer-reviewed paper was not reachable.

## Sources
1. Battery recycling 2026 — IEA. https://iea.example/reports/battery-recycling-2026
2. Recycling roundup — Battery News. https://batterynews.example/recycling-roundup
